name: Nex-N2.5-mini

lineage.how_derived: builds on the multimodal foundation of Nex-N2 with post-training for computer use, web browsing and visually grounded agent work; the Max model is a separate 1.6T text-only MoE

purpose: Agentic model family for long-horizon tasks in real-world environments; the mini and Pro models add computer-use and browsing with visual feedback (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (card tag)
license.notes: Card tag apache-2.0; no LICENSE file in the repo, text not read.

architecture.kind: hybrid Gated-DeltaNet plus full attention MoE with vision (Qwen3.5-MoE layout, hidden 2048)

variants.notes: total parameters inferred from the file size (about 35B); the card was not read for a parameter count

pc-12gb.notes: 22.32 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~3 B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

pc-16gb.notes: 22.32 GB file against 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~3 B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

pc-24gb.notes: 22.32 GB file against 21.6 GB VRAM plus 82 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~3 B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

pc-32gb.notes: 22.32 GB file fits the VRAM budget (29.6 GB) with room for KV

mac-16-24gb.notes: 22.32 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 22.32 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 22.32 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

engine_support.notes: Same layout as the Qwen3.5/3.6 35B-A3B MoE, GGUFs exist.

benchmarks.variant: BF16; Nex-N2.5-Pro 82.7, Max 86.1, Claude Opus 5 89.1 (first column of the card table, read as mini)

weaknesses: SWE-Bench Pro 43.8 is far below Qwen3.8-27B (61.7 in the Nanbeige table)
parameter count and active size not read from the card
soft.maturity: 885 likes but only 2.7k downloads; hosted on OpenRouter per the card

tona_fit.reason: A Qwen3.5-MoE-layout agent fine-tune with mixed vendor numbers (strong terminal, weak SWE-Pro). Same machinery as our reference MoE, so cheap to test; no reason to prefer it over Qwen3.8-27B or Qwen3.6-35B-A3B without our own run.
